```lean
intro h
have h1 : n ^ 2 % 3 ∈ {0, 1} := by
  rw [mod_eq_mod_of_lt, mod_self]
  exact (le_refl 3)
obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_eq_add_mul_div h
have h2 : (n ^ 2 + 1) % 3 = 0 := by rw [mod_add_right, hk, mod_zero]
cases h1 with a
· exact absurd h2 (by rw [a]; exact ne_of_gt (lt_trans (lt_zero_of_pos (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 a)) (lt_add_right zero_lt_one))
· exact absurd h2 (by rw [a]; exact ne_of_gt (lt_trans (lt_zero_of_pos (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 a)) (lt_add_right zero_lt_one)))
```
